fine_lines.title: went vs did ... go
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الجملة المثبتة نستخدم الماضي: I went. وفي السؤال نستخدم did مع المصدر: Where did you go? (وليس Where did you went?)
fine_lines.explanation_en: In positive sentences use the past form (went). In questions use did + base verb (go), not did + went.

fine_lines.title: read (now) vs read (past)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفعل read يُكتب بنفس الشكل في المضارع والماضي، لكن النطق يختلف: المضارع ريد، والماضي رِد مثل كلمة red.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Read is spelled the same in present and past, but the past sounds like "red".

fine_lines.title: at the weekend vs on the weekend
fine_lines.explanation_ar: البريطانيون يقولون at the weekend والأمريكيون يقولون on the weekend. وكلاهما صحيح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: British English says at the weekend; American English says on the weekend. Both are correct.

grammar.title: Past simple: regular and irregular verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط لأشياء انتهت في الماضي (مثل عطلة نهاية الأسبوع الماضية). الأفعال المنتظمة نضيف لها ed: watch → watched, play → played. والأفعال الشاذة لها شكل خاص: go → went, eat → ate, have → had, make → made, read → read.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past simple for finished actions. Regular verbs add -ed (watched, played). Irregular verbs change: go → went, eat → ate, have → had, make → made, read → read.
examples: I watched a film at home.
I played frisbee in the park.

grammar.title: Past simple questions with did
grammar.explanation_ar: السؤال في الماضي: (كلمة سؤال) + did + الفاعل + الفعل في المصدر. What did you do? Where did you go? What did you eat? ولا نستخدم الماضي بعد did.
grammar.explanation_en: Questions: (question word) + did + subject + base verb. Don't use the past form after did.
examples: What did you do at the weekend?
What kind of cake did you make?

grammar.title: was in the past
grammar.explanation_ar: ماضي is/am هو was: How was your weekend? It was great.
grammar.explanation_en: The past of is/am is was.
